radio.channel: Free-space / AWGN reference; no clutter, fading or interference

service_policy.basis: Simulated packet delivery over the trailing 10 one-second samples
service_policy.Good: Current geometric access and at least 95% of offered unique packets delivered in each direction
service_policy.Weak: Current geometric access and some packets delivered in both directions, below Strong in either direction
service_policy.Outage: No current geometric access, or no packets delivered in at least one direction
service_policy.design_margin_basis: min(UL Eb/N0, DL Eb/N0) minus 8.55 dB; 3 dB reserve is retained as a separate design criterion
service_policy.startup: Before ten samples exist, use all available samples; packet history is not cleared at handover

model: Python SGP4 geometry / hypothetical n256 AWGN payload
population: 100 synthetic users in nonuniform regional clusters: Riyadh 30, Jeddah 25, Madinah 15, Dammam 20, Abha 10

provenance.window_selection: Starts at the existing dataset epoch and extends for at least 100 minutes and 1.02 times the longest nominal orbital period. Not an unbiased full-day coverage study.
provenance.propagator: SGP4 WGS72 via Skyfield; ITRS Earth-fixed output
provenance.input: Synthetic five-plane SGP4 design with an audited three-satellite Saudi opening pass.
limits: Synthetic simulation, not live spacecraft tracking.
Project IDs are not real NORAD catalogue identities.
BSTAR and mean-motion derivatives are assumed zero.
Surface geometry uses WGS84.
Earth-fixed conversion uses Skyfield ITRS, not the old report's approximate GMST conversion.
Bundled time-scale data; no added polar-motion corrections.
Existing nonuniform user positions are preserved.
Fixed radio settings remain a hypothetical research payload.
Enlarged spacecraft models and attitudes are illustrative.
ISL results exclude terminal acquisition and switching delay.
Extended frozen orbital replay, not live telemetry. A full revolution does not imply continuous Saudi coverage or return to the same Earth-fixed longitude.
Geometric candidates are independent region-pointed beams; simultaneous beam allocation and RF-qualified service are reported separately.
The current replay contains 6001 samples at1s over6000s; the24h audit uses10s sampling.
Synthetic SGP4 orbital design, not real operational telemetry. Project names are aliases.
Three simultaneous Saudi passes are demonstrated over sampled windows; continuous triple coverage is not claimed.
Inside Saudi uses the provided Natural Earth country outline, not cadastral or precise legal boundaries.
Full-region candidates require elevation>=10deg for every stored regional user and off-axis<=4.416deg for an independently region-pointed beam.
The same three satellites can be candidates for all five regions independently; this does not establish fifteen concurrent beams or radio-qualified service.
Radio payload,200kbit/s design rate and thresholds are unchanged. Geometric availability is not a working-link guarantee.
Minimum pair spacing is sampled; it is not continuous-time conjunction analysis or collision certification.
Comparison uses the same new30/25/15/20/10 population and replay start for both orbital designs.
Only the replay start shifts; OMM element epoch remains2000-01-01. States and orbit curves are freshly propagated, never circularly shifted.
Browser BER uses a numerical erfc approximation, checked against SciPy.
Exported orbital parameters are documented in the design report; sampled phase and distance checks are not a collision-avoidance guarantee.
Simulated instantaneous assignment. No beam-slew, acquisition, interference, handover protocol, or bandwidth scheduler is modeled. Geometric coverage does not imply a non-negative radio margin.

allocation_policy.name: Conservative two-beam regional allocation
allocation_policy.eligibility: Every user in the region satisfies the preserved elevation and off-axis geometry.
objective: Maximize regions with at least one allocated beam
Prefer higher mean link margin, then retain ties
allocation_policy.primary_selection: Highest calculated link margin per user among allocated satellites; ties use the lower satellite index.
allocation_policy.packet_basis: One primary link per user per sample; original seeded packet outcomes, averaged over the trailing ten samples. No duplicated backup traffic.
allocation_policy.status_basis: Simulated packet delivery over the trailing 10 one-second samples
allocation_policy.radio_capability_basis: Separate RF criterion: geometric access and link margin at least 0 dB; packet service does not imply this criterion is met.
allocation_policy.scope: Simulated instantaneous assignment. No beam-slew, acquisition, interference, handover protocol, or bandwidth scheduler is modeled. Geometric coverage does not imply a non-negative radio margin.
